answer: An agent network deters Sybils by verifying localized solar irradiance profiles across an island microgrid. Each node records real-time ultraviolet flux inside a cryptographic hardware vault, validating diurnal curves as the sun reaches its zenith. Because microscale cloud turbulence prevents synthetic replication, an adversary must deploy dedicated physical photodetectors per identity. However, dense overcast homogenizes optical scattering, temporarily degrading verification accuracy.
